brand.name: Optimize3D
brand.positioning: Industrial 3D point-cloud data company for field decisions, quality inspection, reverse engineering, and robotics

hero.eyebrow: Connecting 3D scan data to field decisions and execution data
hero.title: Explore large scans. Make clearer decisions.
hero.body: 3D scanning, point cloud analysis and lightweight streaming for shipyards, construction and manufacturing. Our proprietary Optree LOD engine and spatial AI connect field data to inspection, shape comparison and reverse engineering.

dataStack.title: Field Data Capture
dataStack.body: Point clouds, CAD, photos, inspection criteria, and workspace constraints are organized by project.

dataStack.title: AI Analysis & Spatial Reasoning
dataStack.body: Segmentation, feature extraction, deviation candidates, collision risks, and accessibility are computed as usable data.

dataStack.title: Inspection, Fabrication & Robot Execution
dataStack.body: The results are delivered as inspection reports, CAD reconstruction, jig concepts, and Physical AI execution data.

featuredCase.title: Lightweight Streaming of Large-Scale Point Clouds
featuredCase.body: Explore ultra-scale point clouds where you need them. Our proprietary Optree LOD engine presents an overview first, then progressively loads data for the current view and level of detail.

highlight.title: Lightweight exploration
highlight.body: Lightweight visualization with our proprietary Optree LOD engine

seo.title: Optimize3D | 3D Scanning, Point Cloud Analysis & Streaming
seo.description: Optimize3D connects 3D scanning, point cloud analysis and proprietary Optree LOD streaming to inspection, reverse engineering and AI dataset preparation for shipyards, construction and manufacturing.

services.title: 3D scanning & registration
services.body: Review field conditions for ship blocks, building structures and industrial facilities, then define scan coverage and coordinate references. Register captured point clouds to prepare data for subsequent analysis.

services.title: Shape comparison & inspection
services.body: Compare 3D scans with CAD or reference shapes. Review deviation analysis and reporting scope around the inspection target and evaluation criteria.

services.title: Reverse engineering & AI datasets
services.body: Extract relevant geometry and regions from scans for Scan-to-CAD reverse engineering and labeled datasets. Define deliverables around drawings, reference models and training objectives.

industryApplications.title: Shipyards & marine engineering
industryApplications.body: Explore ship-block, cargo-hold and support point clouds for object separation, geometry review and installation-state analysis.

industryApplications.title: Construction & infrastructure
industryApplications.body: Review potential workflows such as lightweight navigation of building and facility point clouds and comparison with CAD references. Define a pilot around available data and site conditions.

industryApplications.title: Manufacturing & plants
industryApplications.body: Register scan data from parts, molds, piping and industrial facilities for shape comparison, reverse engineering and workspace review.
